The acceptance contract is `tests/test_w35_r2_S.py` plus the real-browser 4→script `tests/browser/w35_r2_S.cjs`, committed by the planner together with a small update to 5→`tests/test_w35_P.py` (it pinned the old status-frame rules byte for byte). Every item below was built and 6→proven on a reference copy first; the code in this brief is that reference. Make the tests pass 7→without editing any file under `tests/`. If a test looks wrong, stop and report the test name and the 8→reason. 9→ 10→## The defect, in one paragraph 11→ 12→On the party status page (`ui/party/status.html`), `ui/switch-bar.css` frames the page in a fixed 13→screen from 654px of height: switch bar, header, "Look up a reference number" box, "My disputes" 14→list. The lookup box was allowed to shrink (`flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0`) below its own title, 15→field, error line and Check status button, so the controls overflowed onto the list. The list painted 16→over the button: it could not be tapped. `body` is `overflow: hidden` there, so nothing could scroll 17→to it. In an exported replay the replay banner (inserted by `tools/replay/replay-shim.js` as the 18→first child of ``, 48 to 120px tall) takes room the 654px figure never budgeted, and the same 19→overlap appears with no error showing at 320px wide. The same overlap appears live whenever the error 20→line or the text is bigger than the empty box was measured with. 21→ 22→## The fix, in one paragraph 23→ 24→The lookup box never shrinks (`flex: none`). The lookup RESULT leaves the box and becomes its own 25→block under it, so that the result (and the header, down to 4.5rem, and the list, down to 8rem) are 26→the only things that give way. The result keeps a floor of 5rem and scrolls inside its own window. 27→`.status-shell` gets `overflow-y: auto` as the last resort: when the floors still do not fit (a long 28→error message, big text, a replay banner on a short phone) the shell scrolls, so nothing is ever 29→covered and nothing is cut off with the page unable to scroll. The 654px threshold stays: it was 30→re-measured with the error line present (see Verify). 31→ 32→## Protocol (obey it on every turn) 33→ 34→This round runs headlessly on `glm-5.3-flash` at max effort. Do not switch models. 35→ 36→- Work only in this repository. No other worktrees, planning or scratch folders, no subagents, no 37→ network, no live model (never pass `--llm tencent`; the server defaults to the mock). 38→- Interpreter: `/usr/bin/python3` with `PYTHONPATH` removed (`env -u PYTHONPATH ...`). 39→- A server you start binds a port in 18000-18999, never 8000-8010, and you stop it before you finish. 40→- Never `rm -rf`, never `git add -A`, never merge, never push.
